title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15

ai_review.summary: Unlistenable recording plagued by static with no discernible music
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer reports that the tape is nothing but static and offers no audible performance, making this release effectively unusable. No musical details are provided, so the show cannot be evaluated beyond its poor recording condition.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 1‑star review describing complete loss of audio; both show and recording quality are judged extremely low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Static throughout, no audible content; reviewer cannot hear anything.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No musical information available due to inaudible recording
